vintage: OpenStreetMap retrieved 2026-11-28; special national relics as listed on Vietnamese Wikipedia (retrieved 2026-11-28)

rules.relic: Every special national relic (di tích quốc gia đặc biệt) in the Vietnamese Wikipedia list, which follows the Prime Minister's ranking decisions (one per round). Placed at the coordinates given in the list, else at the coordinates of the relic's own Wikipedia article (GeoData, else its Wikidata item), else a named OpenStreetMap historic feature or place of worship whose name contains the relic's name or article title (at least two words; all matches within 5 km of each other); the last three only when they fall within 3 km of the province the list names (former or 2025 name). Relics that none of these places are left off the map (listed in unplaced).
